sources.title: A Statistical Theory of Contrastive Pre-training and Multimodal ...
sources.snippet: Multi-modal generative AI systems, such as those combining vision and language, rely on contrastive pre-training to learn representations across different modalities. While their practical benefits are widely acknowledged, a rigorous theoretical understanding of the contrastive pre-training framework remains limited.
